mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_exam_paper (course_id, title, total_score, class_id, teacher_id, create_time) VALUES (#{courseId}, #{title}, #{totalScore}, #{classId}, #{teacherId}, NOW())

INSERT INTO tb_paper_question (paper_id, question_id, score) VALUES
(#{paperId}, #{item.questionId}, #{item.score})
mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.title, p.total_score as totalScore, p.class_id as classId, p.create_time as createTime, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_paper_question pq WHERE pq.paper_id = p.id) as questionCount FROM tb_exam_paper p WHERE p.teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND p.course_id = #{courseId} ORDER BY p.id DESC
